title: Best Makeup Palette (2026)
summary: A concise guide to the top makeup palettes of 2026.
method: Selections were made by reviewing the listed sources and choosing products mentioned by more than one source, prioritizing those with the most detailed descriptions.
assumptions: Prices are omitted because none of the sources provide them.

products.name: Well People Eyeshadow Palette
why: Well People is named the best for matte & shimmer palette in The Good Trade article.
It offers both matte and shimmer shades.
products.desc: Well People is an eyeshadow palette that includes both matte and shimmer shades. It is designed for quick, polished application.
products.benefit: Picture a makeup artist who needs a quick, polished look for clients. The palette offers both matte and shimmer shades, allowing for versatile looks. It outperforms other picks by providing a wide range of finishes in a single palette. The catch: it may not have as many shades as larger palettes.
